title: Shiftory agent-quality benchmark rubric (auditor-only ground truth)
description: Lives in the same public, open-source repository as everything else -- it is NOT secret. It is withheld from the materialized agent prompt package (see agent_quality/README.md), not hidden from a determined reader of this repository. Defines required behaviors and their importance/evidence anchors/appropriate-uncertainty level; it does not define how any specific candidate performed (see candidate-evaluation-v1 for that).

truth_status.description: Guides the auditor's confidence_appropriate judgment on mapped claims (what expressed confidence is calibrated for this fact), not which claim verdict counts as coverage -- coverage always requires a supported_correct-graded claim, including for an ambiguous_unresolvable fact where the correct, supported_correct claim is an honest 'the evidence does not resolve this' statement.

heuristic_aliases.description: Plain literal tokens/phrases used only by heuristic.py's substring/token-set matcher, which never interprets them as regular expressions. This list is a labeled, non-authoritative matching aid, not an answer key.
